verdict.rationale: Casium is an immigration services SaaS platform with a client portal, so issuing scoped API credentials for agents is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no API, API keys, token scoping or least-privilege credentials, and probes for OpenAPI specs and llms.txt all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
